column2: Create or update testable product requirements and specs. Use for a new project or feature before technical design.
Create and review a concrete technical design for an existing spec. Use before implementing a planned feature.
Write and run tests against a spec, then record acceptance and BDD evidence. Use after implementation.
Review frontend architecture for a non-trivial UI change. Use before implementing frontend structure or UX changes.
Load the mandatory spec-driven workflow, engineering, testing, security, versioning, and review rules before working in this repository.
